name: Tokyo Dome Hotel
accessSummary: About 2 min walk from the East Exit of Suidobashi Station (JR Sobu Line) / about 1 min walk from Exit A2 of Suidobashi Station (Toei Mita Line) / about 5 min walk from Exit 2 of Korakuen Station (Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line and Namboku Line) / about 6 min walk from Exit 6 of Kasuga Station (Toei Oedo Line). By car, use the Nishi-Kanda or Iidabashi exit of the Metropolitan Expressway.
notice: The banquet plan use time is 2 hours (2 hours 30 minutes for the Saturday and Sunday only plan), and a basic audio and lighting fee is charged separately from the price. For meetings there is a weekday-only Meeting Plan (15-40 people; 2, 4 or 8 hours between 9:00 and 17:00). Lectures, press conferences, interviews and photo shoots are not covered by the Meeting Plan. High-speed internet in the banquet rooms is 16,500 yen (tax included) per line per day, and one line is charged even when it is used the day before for checks or for rehearsal.

ops.parking: There is a car park on B2 and B3. The fee is 400 yen per 30 minutes on weekdays and 500 yen per 30 minutes on Saturdays, Sundays, holidays and specified days (tax included), with no maximum charge. Vehicles are limited to 3.3-5.0m in length, 1.4-1.9m in width, 2.1m or less in height and 2.5t or less in weight; large buses and vehicles taller than 2.1m cannot enter. Parking cannot be reserved, and entry may be restricted when it is crowded, such as when an event is held at Tokyo Dome. The hotel car park is limited to users of the hotel's facilities. The parking fee service for banquet users differs by banquet, so ask the banquet staff.
ops.waitingRooms: The small banquet rooms on B1 (4 rooms: Rainbow, Color, Radiance and Echo, 45-49㎡ each) can also be used as waiting rooms for guests of honor. The layout example for Rainbow is a waiting room for 20 people.
ops.catering: The usage rules ask that food and drink not be ordered from outside the hotel or brought in.
ops.restaurants: With the weekday-only Meeting Plan, private rooms of the 6F dining restaurant "Deux Mille" can be used (April 1, 2026 to March 31, 2027). Salon 1 "Soleil" is 55,000 yen per room for up to 14 people, and Salon 2 "Ciel" is 35,000 yen per room for up to 8 people, for 3 hours between 10:00 and 16:00 (no extension). The price includes room charge, service charge and consumption tax, and comes with a screen, projector and PC extension cable. Reserve at least 3 days before the day of use. Lectures, press conferences, interviews and photo shoots are not covered.
